title: Multitask LQG Control: Performance and Generalization Bounds
summary: We study multitask learning for stochastic and partially observed control systems, focusing on the linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) problem. Our goal is to learn a common stabilizing controller that generalizes across a distribution of systems and objectives. To this end, we leverage a history-dependent lifting that recasts the multitask LQG problem into an equivalent high-dimensional multitask LQR problem, allowing for the analysis of policy gradient methods.
